name: higgsfield-websites
description: | Build, edit, and deploy full-stack websites, apps and games via the Higgsfield CLI (`higgsfield website …`). Each is a React 19 + TanStack Start SSR app in one Cloudflare Worker (D1/R2/KV/DO/Containers). THREE product types, picked via `--type` on create: `website` (standalone, no Higgsfield integration — references/website-flow.md), `app` (Sign in with Higgsfield + fnf SDK, Quanta — references/app-flow.md), `game` (realtime multiplayer rooms — references/game-flow.md).
